annotations.title: Find a coach near a place

description: Find cycling and running coaches and training groups near a place, e.g. personal cycling trainer in Johannesburg, running coach near Sandton, coaches near Fourways. Use it for any coach, personal trainer, coaching or training group question (never find_clubs, which lists clubs). Lists coaches and training groups on Windline (cycling) and RunFast (running) nearest first, with what they coach (road, MTB, gravel, triathlon, beginners, racing, marathon, ultra), how (1-on-1, small group, online), their next group session with its weather, whether beginners are welcome, the qualifications they state in their own words (livedot doesn't check them), a Book / contact link (their own) and their page. Only coaches who listed themselves and added their area; never anyone else. Say what each coach chose to share, and nothing more.

beginners.description: true when the user is new to the sport ("for beginners", "new to running").

format.description: one-to-one for a personal trainer or private coaching, group for a training group or small group, online for remote coaching.

km.description: How far from the place, in km (1 to 100). Leave it out for 25 km.

place.description: The suburb, town or city, as the user said it, e.g. "Fourways", "Durban North", "Cape Town".

specialty.description: What the coach coaches, if the user said: road, mtb, gravel, triathlon, beginners, racing, marathon or ultra.

sport.description: cycling or running. Leave it out for both.

units.description: Pass the asker's units: imperial for users in the US, UK road distances, Liberia or Myanmar, or when they ask in miles/°F; otherwise metric.

name: find_coaches

outputSchema.description: Coaches and training groups near a place, nearest first.

add_club.description: Where a club that isn't listed asks to be added: { cycling (Windline's page application), running (RunFast's Add your club) }.

add_coach.description: Where a coach who isn't listed gets listed free: { cycling (Windline's page application, I'm a coach), running (RunFast's Add your club, I'm a coach) }.

app.description: windline, or runfast when every row is a running club or event.

coaches.description: Nearest first: id, app, name, url (their livedot.me page), book (Book / contact: their own link, or their page), photo, km, area, sports, specialties, format, qualifications (their own words, never checked), beginners_welcome, sessions (one line), next ({ start, place, kind, weather, weather_basis }).

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong, in words for the user.

format.description: one-to-one, group or online, or null.

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user (no match, not live yet, a question back).

place.description: The place searched, as found on the map.

signup.description: Without a sign-in: { label, url } to make a free Windline or RunFast account (?ref=mcp).

specialty.description: The specialty asked for, or null.

sponsor_line.description: The line every answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free.

sport.description: The sport asked for, or null for all.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).

title: Find a coach near a place
